description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You'll Do

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the Risk Based Exposure Management team, which allows our customers to answer the questions: what do I need to fix right now, what can I ignore, and how do I justify my decisions to my board and auditors? Business-risk lives here. Combined with the proof of exploitability that only NodeZero provides, RBEM layers in context and data from various different sources, filters all of it down, and delivers the most comprehensive understanding of where real risk lies in a customer's environment.

You will lead a small, high-impact team of engineers. You will be accountable for the team's operational health, outcomes, and hiring, mentoring, and retaining engineers. You'll partner with Product and Design to turn company direction into a clear quarterly roadmap and deliver on it consistently.

This role suits a manager who is technically credible. While you won't be expected to code a lot, you'll need to understand the team's systems well enough to ask good questions in design reviews, spot delivery and technical risk early, and work with the team to resolve it before it impacts customers or the team.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Owning the output, delivery, and health of the RBEM team, including accountability for its performance and quality of work.

  • Defining team priorities and near-term strategy in line with department goals, and building and delivering a quarterly roadmap.

  • Translating company and department direction into clear team goals, and explaining the "why" so the team is bought in.

  • Balancing new initiatives against operational work, maintenance, and technical debt.

  • Running effective team cadences (sprint planning, standups, retros, backlog grooming), directly or through delegation, and keeping the ticketing system accurate. Projects should be broken into trackable milestones and be visible to stakeholders.

  • Coordinating cross-team dependencies, escalating blockers with enough context for leadership to act, and protecting the team's focus from noise and interruptions.

  • Owning hiring for the team: defining role needs, attracting strong candidates, interviewing, and contributing to calibration.

  • Onboarding new engineers and setting them up to succeed quickly.

  • Mentoring and developing engineers across career levels: holding regular, high-quality 1:1s on near-term work and long-term growth and creating appropriate growth opportunities.

  • Retaining top talent by understanding what motivates each engineer, recognizing strong performance, and addressing concerns before they escalate.

  • Giving timely, direct feedback, and addressing underperformance clearly and early.

  • Creating a psychologically safe team where engineers raise concerns, take risks, and learn from mistakes.

What You'll Bring

  • Demonstrated ability to lead a team of engineers to deliver on a roadmap, with a record of consistent execution.

  • Experience hiring, onboarding, and developing engineers, and keeping a small team engaged and growing.

  • Ability to coach engineers at different stages, from early-career to senior, and match growth opportunities to each person.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including explaining tradeoffs and delivery risk to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Sound judgment under ambiguity and a pragmatic approach to prioritization.

  • A product-minded focus on customer outcomes.

  • A commitment to developing your own management skills and an understanding that while technical understanding is important, your people are your first priority.

Required Education/Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, combined with a minimum of 2+ years of people management or formal technical lead experience.

  • Experience building and operating production services on a cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including APIs and asynchronous or event-driven systems.

  • Familiarity with SQL relational databases and data modeling in production.

  • Experience with observability, reliability, and on-call practices for production services.

  • Experience managing a distributed or remote team.

  • Experience integrating AI-assisted development into team workflows while keeping quality high.

  • Experience partnering with product managers to define and sequence an MVP.

Preferred Education/Experience

You don't need all of these, but experience in some of the following will help you be successful quickly:

  • Experience with PostgreSQL at scale, graph databases such as Neo4j, GraphQL, or ETL and data-processing pipelines.

  • Experience in vulnerability management, exposure management, security telemetry, or related cybersecurity domains.

  • Experience with scoring, prioritization, or recommendation systems and data-intensive products.

Travel Required

We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 10% of travel to be successful. We meet as a team for project kick offs and as a company annually. These in-person meetings are crucial to building a product, team, and culture we all can be proud of.

 

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $225,000 - $265,000. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
